exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "might / possibly".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! ～かもしれない matches "might / possibly".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is ～かもしれない.
exercises.explanation: Expresses uncertainty or possibility; means "might" or "maybe."
